1. Rewrite the potential in Cartesian coordinates  

   cos θ = x/r   ⇒   cos² θ = x² / r² = x² /(x² + y²)

   V(r,θ) = ½ k r² + 3⁄2 k r² cos² θ  
          = ½ k (x² + y²) + 3⁄2 k (x² + y²)(x² /(x² + y²))  
          = ½ k y² + (½ k + 3⁄2 k) x²  
          = ½ k y² + 2 k x².

   Thus the motion separates into two independent 1-D harmonic oscillators:

   • along x:  V_x = ½ m ω_x² x² with ½ m ω_x² = 2k  ⇒  ω_x = 2√(k/m)  
   • along y:  V_y = ½ m ω_y² y² with ½ m ω_y² = ½k ⇒  ω_y = √(k/m)

2. Energy of a 2-D separable harmonic oscillator  

   E = (n_x + ½)ħω_x + (n_y + ½)ħω_y  
     = (n_x + ½)ħ(2√{k/m}) + (n_y + ½)ħ√{k/m}  

   = [2n_x + n_y + (1 + ½)] ħ√(k/m)  
   = (2n_x + n_y + 3/2) ħ√(k/m).

3. Identify the option matching this expression:  

   Option (D):  E = (2n_x + n_y + 3/2) ħ√(k/m).

Answer: D
